notes.subject: ol animal nogut
notes.rationale: חיה רעה em i 'ol kaikai man nogut'; 'animal nogut' i holim piksa bilong Hibru

notes.subject: sik nogut
notes.rationale: דבר em i sik nupela i kilim planti man, olsem 'pestilence'

notes.subject: ושכלך
notes.rationale: Sampla tanim tok i tok 'ol bai makim yu i no gat pikinini' (KJV 'bereave') o 'ol bai bagarapim yu' (BSB 'leave you childless')

notes.subject: long Yerusalayim
notes.rationale: Ol tok hia i go stret long taun Yerusalayim, olsem meri (עליך בך)

translation: Na bai mi salim ⟨i kam⟩ long yu hangre, na ol animal nogut, na ol bai skelim yu i lusim ol pikinini, na sik nogut na blut bai i go antap long yu, na bai mi bringim bainat i kam long yu. Mi, Yahwe, mi tokim ol dispela tok.

tokens.gloss: na ol bai skelim yu i lusim ol pikinini
